**Finding: TRANSITION — missing (fallback redline proposed).**

- **What I checked:** the whole of Article XII (12.1–12.6), including every sub-paragraph of 12.3(c)(vi)A–I, 12.3(d), 12.3(e), survival at 12.4, and Section 11.6 (Return of Confidential Information).
- **Direction analysis:** all of the existing exit machinery (Know-How, regulatory materials, trademarks, inventory, technical and commercial transition assistance) is owed by **Sanofi to RevMed**. Those clauses burden us and were not flagged. The only RevMed-side assistance (12.3(e)) is confined to termination for a Change of Control of RevMed by a Major Biopharmaceutical Company, with no duration and no data-export deadline. Section 11.6 is destruction-on-request of Confidential Information, not return/export of our data, and has no fixed period.
- **Cure:** a single insert as new Section 12.3(f) (inside the surviving Section 12.3), carrying exactly the three fallback elements — obligations triggered on expiration or termination for any reason, at least 90 days of transition assistance, and export/delivery of our data within 30 days. No survival tail, cost language, or other non-element boilerplate was added.
